blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Conditions let a program choose, and loops let it repeat. Both depend on tests that give 1 (true) or 0 (false). Any value other than 0 counts as true.

blocks.title: if, else if, else
Operators
items: 0 is false, anything else is true

blocks.title: for loop

blocks.body: Check the ends of your range. `i < n` repeats n times from 0. Add `break` to each `case`.
